content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lansing

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus additional experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours requirements to confirm you qualify before enrolling in our training program.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, learn from active certified practitioners, and earn the 35 contact hours PMI mandates for PMP eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing our course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, upload required documentation, and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the process and verify your course completion.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice exams, and instructor support to build confidence. Schedule your proctored PMP exam with Pearson VUE and demonstrate your project-management knowledge and readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over PMI's standard 3-year renewal cycle through training, certifications, and professional activities. Renew your credential on schedule to keep your competitive advantage in Lansing's competitive job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
